lanes.title: caps count battlefield units (D-082 DA5) and army scale at every stage (DA3)
lanes.brief: SCOPE LIMITS: work only in prototypes/m7-sprint1 (M7Proto.slnx; M7Econ.slnx only if economy code is touched) and docs/m7-plan; no change to Sim.Core, Sim.Data, Sim.Cli, Sim.Ui or their tests, no unit data or cap change, no permanent project, no CI change (D-079 §6, Q5 open). Every design document is marked PROPOSAL; every reading is labelled READING with both alternatives; no Director decision is invented or reopened. Read docs/d082-morale-caps-ties-director-answers-2026-11-10.md in full first (the Director's message of 2026-11-10, DA1-DA9, its readings DA1-R..DA8-R, §3 supersessions, §5 not decided). (1) CAPS COUNT BATTLEFIELD UNITS (DA5; DA5-R (a): a battle entity in lane W's rule, a formation of P persons fights as n <= cap entities, reports/H-W.md §5, BattleCollapse). Lane D's caps prototype counts persons (Proto.M7/Caps/DirectorCaps.cs CountOf, FormationRoster, and the sandbox Quick Battle split in Proto.M7/Sandbox/SandboxSession.cs); D-082 supersedes that. Make ONE rule for lanes W and D: caps bound the entities a formation fights as; a formation's size in persons is limited by the economy, not by the cap. Keep the mortar crewed tube (lane D §2.1, one entity per tube) and lane N's CAP-5 treatment. Update every affected test with a measured attribution for each moved pin. (2) DESIGN PROPOSAL (update docs/m7-plan/caps-and-counted-objects-proposal.md in place, marking each change '(D-082 DA5)' and quoting what it replaces, or a new docs/m7-plan/battle-entity-proposal.md linked from it): what one battle entity stands for when it represents many persons: persons per entity with the remainder rule (exact conservation, Law 1), its hit points, its morale weight, its fire and melee output, how casualties map back to persons, and the AutoResolver's representation; the consequences that follow from lane D's §2.2 (CAP-1 and CAP-2 dissolve; no data row needs a retune); performance at large P; the entity's morale weight alongside lanes MOR and MOR2 (DA1's rise, DR29's decrease and D-083's entry cost are settled per formation and per army; say whether anything changes when one formation fights as many entities). Cite every data row an option touches without changing it. (3) ARMY SCALE AT EVERY STAGE (DA3): update docs/m7-plan/economic-scale-proposal.md to record DA3 and lay out the calibration path for absolute numbers at every stage: which existing levers (recruitment cost, recurring maintenance, the personnel predicate, food and logistics) keep 500-1,000 troops readily achievable and 50,000 difficult from early turns to turn 1630, when the driver polity numbers 80.1M-90.2M on HEAD (lane D, MEASURED); MEASURE with the economy prototype's scale probe (prototypes/m7-sprint1/Proto.M7.Econ/ScaleProbe.cs, --driver research --twin-at) the research twins at turns 100, 325 and 400 that lane D did not run, over several seeds; both food orderings where a result depends on them (DR27, Q3 OPEN). No data change; the calibration itself goes through ADR-055 amendment A-38 and M7.14 later. (4) Lane report prototypes/m7-sprint1/reports/H-CB.md (what exists, design, readings, Director decisions only where genuinely undecided, MEASURED vs INFERRED, tests, mutants, what ran, NOT RUN, deferred). Builds and tests: M7Proto.slnx and M7Econ.slnx Debug and Release, the determinism scan, the doc links.
